'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]].

The items can be stored in a [[STASH]] unit, requiring {{SCP|Construction|55|link=yes}}, 2 [[teak plank|teak planks]], 10 [[nails]] and a [[hammer]] and [[saw]] to build.
